family.name: ClearHistory scalar counters and totals
family.shortlist_status: source-only candidate cohort; not an ownership admission

lifecycle.ClearHistory_call_alias_identity: o24_39C7_01B8 is registered at S24:39C7:01B8, same entry as ClearHistory
lifecycle.newGame_reset_limit: Five totals/flags reset only under newGame == 1. Other candidate stores are unconditional inside ClearHistory, but both call-path coverage and raw SaveRec replacement prevent claiming universal lifecycle or bounded values.
lifecycle.raw_load_semantics: LoadGame reads count*size bytes into each saved data pointer without validating values; SaveRec establishes serialized byte views and raw pointer use, not legal value ranges.

limits: No original executable or original object/data bytes were read, compiled, or linked; the SOURCE_ONLY_DOS input guard ran before audit or probe work.
SaveRec stores are raw size/count byte spans and LoadGame does not validate values. This probe establishes typed source widths and test-owned zero startup, not legal game values.
Five ClearHistory stores are guarded by newGame == 1; reset call coverage does not establish universal lifecycle. Save loading can restore arbitrary raw patterns.
The independent history-array owner and seven spider/corpse counter owner were used only as exclusions; none of their owned extents intersects these twelve scalar targets.
This proposes source-functional scalar storage only. It makes no claim about original COMDEF-producing TU, communal order, padding, or physical placement.
lifecycle_and_limits.scope: Functional source-owned scalar storage only; no historical COMDEF TU/order, original placement, padding, or unrestricted raw-load value-safety claim.
